capabilities: Sync Markdown, images, PDFs, and other files to Baidu Netdisk manually or automatically
Merge compatible Markdown edits three-way and resolve overlaps in a conflict editor
Pair devices by exporting and importing password-encrypted authorization codes
Recover unfinished tasks and restore local recovery points after interruptions
Create, bind, and inspect cloud vaults with version listings
extras: UI and settings messages are primarily in Chinese; deletion propagation is off by default; large-file limits differ by platform (desktop 512 MiB, mobile 20 MiB); the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff; cloud notes are not end-to-end encrypted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep vaults in sync through Baidu Netdisk, and syncing without version history risks silent overwrites between devices.

requires.name: Baidu Netdisk account with an approved application (AppKey/SecretKey)

summary: Syncs vault notes and attachments through the user's own Baidu Netdisk account, with version tracking, conflict resolution, and encrypted device pairing.
